title: The Heart Ruby
metaDescription: 3.15ct natural ruby heart cluster with brilliant-cut white diamond halo — invisible setting in 18K white gold. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: Natural rubies hold their colour most fully when nothing competes with them. Bez Ambar's invisible-setting technique allows the rubies to present their colour alone — the metal removed entirely from the face, the form shaped as a heart. A diamond halo in 18-karat white gold surrounds it. The technique exists in service of the colour.

specs.label: Gem Stone
specs.body: 3.15 ct · Natural ruby + white diamond · GIA-certified diamonds · Heart cluster — natural rubies with brilliant-cut white diamond halo.

specs.label: Setting
specs.body: Invisible setting — no metal visible on the face of the piece. The rubies present their colour uninterrupted.

specs.label: More Details
specs.body: Designed and made in Los Angeles. Available by private appointment.
